about_the_game:
Pathfinder 2 RPG - Pathfinder Adventure Path #215: To Blot Out the Sun (Shades of Blood 3 of 3)

On the trail of Nizca, the vampire who orchestrated the plan to shroud the sun in shadow, the PCs discover the basement of the central command tower of the former prison. They must ascend the tower from within, fighting past deadly guardians and strange Azlanti magic and machinery, to reach the tower's top where Nizca races to repair their device and successfully blot out the sun so they can reunite with their lover to the east. Can the PCs stop night from falling over Golarion?


To Blot Out the Sun  is a Pathfinder Adventure for four 7th-level characters. This adventure concludes the Shades of Blood Adventure Path, a three-part monthly campaign in which a group of adventurers explore a ruined ancient prison to stop a vampiric threat to cover the skies in shadow. This volume includes a look at a Nin, patron of the campaign's villain and god of mathematical laws of undeath, reveals unsolved mysteries, delves deeper into vampires, and provides a toolbox of magical contraptions and techniques as well as a bestiary of shadowy monsters.

Written by: Jessica Catalan.

This product is not a PDF or accessible outside of Fantasy Grounds. It has been lovingly converted for use within Fantasy Grounds and features the following additions:

<ul> <li> All maps resized and set up with a preset grid to make combats easy to manage</li>
<li> Individual area descriptions linked to maps, containing new encounters, treasure parcels and descriptions for just that area</li>
<li> Tokens for each encounter are all pre-placed in starting locations on the map. You can edit these on the fly.</li>
<li> Drag and drop treasure parcels and Encounter XP that is easily awarded to your players to keep the game moving ahead</li>
<li> All the images and handouts from the book available to share with your players as you need them</li>
</ul>"
